03 / SPATIAL × TEMPORAL LINK

Does floor-area intensity stay active after hours?

Each URA parcel is linked to the POIs located inside it. For every hour, the parcel's known-hours POI open share is calculated, then weighted by that parcel's estimated GFA. Compare this with the unweighted rate for the same matched POI sample.

GFA-weighted vs POI-level availability

Hourly open share (%) · same set of matched POIs and GFA-valid parcels

Map cursor 12:00
GFA-weighted availabilityUnweighted matched-POI availability

Which parcels combine large GFA and night-time activity?

One dot = one parcel · x-axis uses log-scaled estimated GFA · y-axis = mean 22:00–05:00 availability

How to read this carefully: GFA is the clipped parcel area × numeric GPR. The whole parcel GFA is used as a weight when at least one POI on that parcel has known hours; this is a parcel-level activity proxy, not the measured open floor area. Parcels with missing GPR or no known-hours POI are excluded from the weighted denominator. The coverage card reports how much of numeric-GPR GFA entered the proxy. Promenade has only a small number of eligible parcels. POI opening hours are not proof of actual occupancy or public access.

SPATIAL LAYER / URA PLANNING POLYGONS

Land-use diversity and floor-area intensity

Land-area entropy is recalculated across six planning-use classes. GFA estimates use numeric GPR records only; see the coverage column before interpreting the partial GFA index.

Land-use composition

Share of the six-class land area within each catchment

Spatial indicator comparison

Numeric GPR coverage by use class

Share of each land-use class area with numeric GPR

Known GFA by use class

Estimated GFA from numeric GPR parcels only

Primary entropy uses Residential, Mixed, Commercial, Hotel, Civic/Education and Open Space, normalized by ln(6). Roads and residual “Other” are outside this six-class denominator. The six classes cover 69.2% of the Bencoolen buffer, 53.7% of Tanjong Pagar and 49.8% of Promenade. As a sensitivity test, including “Other” as a seventh class gives entropy values of 0.829, 0.722 and 0.526 respectively (Bencoolen, Tanjong Pagar, Promenade); this changes the category set and denominator.
TEMPORAL LAYER / WEEKLY SCHEDULES

Does spatial diversity translate into round-the-clock availability?

Absolute availability = average number of known-schedule POIs open in each hourly slot. Relative availability = the same open count divided by the known-schedule POI count in that district.

Hourly profiles are averages across the days in each group.

Absolute availability

Average open POIs per hour

Relative availability

Open share of known-schedule POIs (%)

Hourly functional diversity

Normalized Shannon entropy of the six amenity categories open in each hour (0–1). Blank cells indicate no open POIs, so diversity is undefined.

Spatial–temporal case comparison

The three districts are descriptive case studies, not a statistical sample. With n = 3, the cross-district comparison does not support a reliable correlation or causal claim between entropy and temporal availability.

04 / RESEARCH METHOD

From spatial mix to temporal access.

Research question: How does amenity availability vary across mixed-use districts, and how can AI-assisted data collection improve our understanding of these patterns?

Spatial frame

400m catchments

Three GIS-derived 400m circular catchments around selected MRT exits. Each clipped buffer is approximately 494,427 m² and is analysed in EPSG:3414.

Temporal frame

7 × 24 hours

Open when any portion of an hourly interval is covered by a known schedule.

Comparison

Absolute + relative

Compare open POI counts and the share of known-schedule POIs open at each hour.

Critical evaluation

Coverage ≠ accuracy

API retrieval is not exhaustive; 51 out-of-buffer results are excluded, and the remaining 129 unknown schedules are not imputed. Coverage does not establish accuracy.

The spatial overlay is now included: six-class land-area entropy is calculated from URA planning polygons clipped to the three GIS catchments. Estimated GFA is clipped parcel area × numeric GPR; non-numeric or missing GPR is not imputed, so GFA entropy is explicitly a partial known-GPR index. A point-in-polygon join assigns 574/595 POIs to land-use parcels and 514/595 to the OSM building footprints supplied with the prototype. Unmatched points remain unassigned; a footprint match does not verify tenancy or building capacity. The AI-assisted opening-hours retrieval and validation pipeline is still not implemented. The new GFA-weighted temporal proxy aggregates known-hours POI opening shares within each matched parcel and weights each parcel by clipped-area × numeric GPR. It is limited to parcels with numeric GPR and at least one known-hours POI; coverage is reported, and the whole parcel GFA is not interpreted as physically open floor area. Do not publish Google-derived POI records without checking applicable licensing terms.
